parameters.content:
## Send Weekly Search Console Report

### How it works

1. Trigger fires every Monday at 8 AM to run the weekly SEO report workflow
2. Date ranges for current and previous week are calculated and stored as variables
3. Six sequential Google Search Console API calls fetch totals, queries, and pages for both weeks
4. Custom code aggregates the data and formats it into a readable report
5. Final report is sent via email to configured recipients
6. Any API errors during data collection automatically trigger an error alert email

### Setup steps

- - [ ] Configure Google account Service Account credentials with access to Google Search Console API
- [ ] Set up Gmail credentials for sending both the report and error alert emails
- [ ] Update the recipient email address in the Send Email node
- [ ] Verify the Google Search Console property URL is correct in all HTTP Request nodes

### Customization

Modify the email recipients or report format in Build Report and Send Email nodes. You can also adjust date range calculations in Build Date Ranges if you need custom reporting periods.

## Weekly Schedule Trigger

Scheduled trigger that initiates the workflow every Monday at 8 AM to generate weekly SEO performance reports.

## Build Date Ranges

Sets current and previous week date ranges for the Google Search Console API queries.

## Search Console Data Collection

Sequential API requests to Google Search Console for search analytics data: totals, queries, and pages for both this week and last week.

## Build and Send Report

Custom code that aggregates all search analytics data and builds a formatted report, then sends it via email.

## Error Alert Handler

Gmail node that receives error signals from all data collection nodes and sends alerts when API requests fail.
